hints.title: Manhattan Distance Comparison
hints.text: Compare your Manhattan distance to the destination with each ghost's Manhattan distance to the destination.

hints.title: Ghost Optimal Interception
hints.text: A ghost can always choose to move straight toward the target rather than chasing your current position.

hints.title: Strict Distance Inequality
hints.text: You can escape if and only if your distance to the target is strictly less than every ghost's distance to the target.
